verdict.rationale:
Kong Gateway is inherently headless (reverse-proxy/data-plane), supports DB-less/declarative deployment and Docker install with no GUI required, and Kong-owned CLIs (decK, Inso CLI) explicitly target CI/CD: 'inso lint spec' fails builds on errors and 'inso run test' returns pass/fail exit codes for pipeline integration. decK is described as facilitating full API Lifecycle Automation (APIOps) via CLI.

missing for 10: independent/community case studies of real CI pipelines using decK/Inso, and admin-API-only automation examples beyond docs.
